title: Hivo
oneLiner: Mobile-first rental marketplace tailored for Saudi Arabia

problem.heading: Problem
problem.description: Global booking platforms lacked cultural relevance, trust signals, and smooth bilingual flows for Saudi travelers and hosts.

myRole.heading: Role
myRole.description: Owned core full-stack features including property management and host flows, collaborating with product and design while mentoring engineers.

solution.heading: Solution
solution.description: Built with the Eignspaces team a mobile-first booking experience with localized discovery, bilingual flows, secure payments, and fast booking journeys.

impact.heading: Impact
impact.description: Launched on iOS with strong early traction, reaching a 5★ rating and rapid host adoption that required pacing new listings.
metrics: 🚀 High demand led to controlled onboarding
